name: Whole Azerbaijan
summary: Whole Azerbaijan is an irredentist nationalism that seeks to reunite the Azerbaijani-inhabited lands split between states, above all the Republic of Azerbaijan and Iranian Azerbaijan, in one Azerbaijani state. It rests on a shared language, history and national identity across the Aras border, and in Elchibey's version it aims to proceed peacefully and democratically, with Karabakh settled first. The record on economics, government and social questions is almost silent.
scope: The Whole Azerbaijan or Unified Azerbaijan idea as held by Azerbaijani opposition nationalists of the 1990s (Popular Front, Musavat, Unified Azerbaijan Party) and set out by Abulfaz Elchibey. It excludes the civic Azerbaijanism of the Azerbaijani state, the wider pan-Turkist programme and the later policies of the Aliyev government.
